title: How Far Are LLMs from Believable AI? A Benchmark for Evaluating the Believability of Human Behavior Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Perturbing the birth year/age in a character's profile (e.g., 1956, 1985, 2000) and measuring changes in the language model's consistency accuracy (CA) when answering questions about the character.

Modifying the stated race of a character in their profile (e.g., African, Caucasian, Middle Eastern) and evaluating the impact on the model's consistency accuracy to see if it performs better for certain demographics.
Substituting character surnames with names associated with different racial or ethnic groups (e.g., Keams, Bedonie, Nguyen) and measuring the variation in the model's consistency performance.

Altering the educational background of a character in their profile (e.g., Middle School, High School, Bachelor's degree) and comparing the language model's consistency accuracy across the different education levels.
